epics.sixSigmaMetric: decrease system launch failure rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The backend application must start successfully and respond to health check requests on port 18080.

slices.title: Resolve connection refused error on backend health check endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the launch fix for this epic, I want to identify and resolve the backend startup crash, so that the application successfully binds to its port and accepts health check connections
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a configured local environment
When the application is launched
Then the backend service successfully initializes without crashing
And the /health endpoint returns a HTTP 200 OK status code on port 18080
slices.sixSigmaMetric: decrease connection refused errors on port 18080 from 1 to 0 per launch attempt
